items.purpose_zh: 在物理刪除前確認沒有 Active Pointer、README、Issue、Workflow、Citation 或外部文件仍解析到舊路徑。
items.purpose_en: Detect active pointers, citations and workflow dependencies before physical reclamation.

items.purpose_zh: 把舊 vendor-specific adapter 經驗抽象成可替換 Carrier Capability Matrix，避免平台名稱重新取得架構權。
items.purpose_en: Abstract vendor-specific bridge knowledge into a replaceable carrier capability matrix.

items.purpose_zh: 為仍可能被引用的舊 family 建立 Legacy → Current Successor 對照與 Reader Redirect。
items.purpose_en: Provide legacy-to-current successor resolution and reader redirects.

items.purpose_zh: 將舊 routing logs 壓縮成可重建的事件／lineage evidence，而不是永久保留整包舊 orchestration body。
items.purpose_en: Compact historical routing logs into reconstructable event and lineage evidence.

items.purpose_zh: 04_interface-layer 的 Qinyi public-value material 由 Ideas 判斷哪些語義仍有效，再由 Release Gate 決定是否形成新的 public projection。
items.purpose_en: Have Ideas re-evaluate legacy public-value semantics before any renewed external projection.
